google.title: Google sign-in
google.description: Link Google as another way to sign in. Your password remains available. Linking and unlinking require a sign-in from the last five minutes.
google.configure: To enable Google, set GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET on the server, then restart it. In Google Cloud, register this authorized redirect URI:
google.linked: Google is linked to your owner account.
google.error: Google sign-in could not finish. Only the Google account linked in your settings can sign in. Try again or use your password.
google.reauthenticate: Sign out and sign back in with your password, then try again. Password access must remain available.
google.domainHint: Replace <yourdomain> with your public domain or subdomain, including a Railway domain. Set BETTER_AUTH_URL to that HTTPS origin and register its exact callback in Google Cloud.
